sessionStart.bash: if [ -n "${NVIM:-}" ]; then nvim --server "$NVIM" --remote-expr "execute('unlet! g:copilot_status | redrawstatus')" >/dev/null; fi

userPromptSubmitted.bash: if [ -n "${NVIM:-}" ]; then nvim --server "$NVIM" --remote-expr "execute('let g:copilot_status = ''thinking'' | redrawstatus')" >/dev/null; fi

permissionRequest.bash: if [ -n "${NVIM:-}" ]; then nvim --server "$NVIM" --remote-expr "execute('if exists(''g:copilot_status'') | let g:copilot_status = ''waiting'' | redrawstatus | endif')" >/dev/null; fi
permissionRequest.powershell: if ($env:NVIM) { nvim --server $env:NVIM --remote-expr "execute('if exists(''g:copilot_status'') | let g:copilot_status = ''waiting'' | redrawstatus | endif')" | Out-Null }

preToolUse.bash: if [ -n "${NVIM:-}" ]; then nvim --server "$NVIM" --remote-expr "execute('if exists(''g:copilot_status'') | let g:copilot_status = ''running'' | redrawstatus | endif')" >/dev/null; fi
preToolUse.powershell: if ($env:NVIM) { nvim --server $env:NVIM --remote-expr "execute('if exists(''g:copilot_status'') | let g:copilot_status = ''running'' | redrawstatus | endif')" | Out-Null }

postToolUse.bash: if [ -n "${NVIM:-}" ]; then nvim --server "$NVIM" --remote-expr "execute('if exists(''g:copilot_status'') | let g:copilot_status = ''thinking'' | redrawstatus | endif')" >/dev/null; fi
postToolUse.powershell: if ($env:NVIM) { nvim --server $env:NVIM --remote-expr "execute('if exists(''g:copilot_status'') | let g:copilot_status = ''thinking'' | redrawstatus | endif')" | Out-Null }

postToolUseFailure.bash: if [ -n "${NVIM:-}" ]; then nvim --server "$NVIM" --remote-expr "execute('if exists(''g:copilot_status'') | let g:copilot_status = ''error'' | redrawstatus | endif')" >/dev/null; fi

agentStop.bash: if [ -n "${NVIM:-}" ]; then nvim --server "$NVIM" --remote-expr "execute('unlet! g:copilot_status | redrawstatus')" >/dev/null; fi

errorOccurred.bash: if [ -n "${NVIM:-}" ]; then nvim --server "$NVIM" --remote-expr "execute('if exists(''g:copilot_status'') | let g:copilot_status = ''error'' | redrawstatus | endif')" >/dev/null; fi

sessionEnd.bash: if [ -n "${NVIM:-}" ]; then nvim --server "$NVIM" --remote-expr "execute('unlet! g:copilot_status | redrawstatus')" >/dev/null; fi
